summary.en: US-Iran tensions spike oil above $90 and push yields higher, weighing on tech-heavy futures across the board. Weak opening sentiment as investors price-in inflation risks from energy markets before September begins.
summary.zh: 美伊紧张局势推升油价突破$90、收益率走高，拖累以科技股为主的期货整体走弱。市场在关注能源板块通胀风险的情况下展开9月交易。

title.en: Oil Surges Above $90 as US-Iran Tensions Flare Up; Futures Drop
title.zh: 油价飙升突破$90，美伊紧张局势升级；期指下跌

topNews.impact: Energy crisis drives inflation expectations higher, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors and broadening risk-off sentiment.

macroRisk.en: Oil above $90 + rising yields = valuation compression for duration-sensitive tech; potential stagflation narrative if sustained.
macroRisk.zh: 油价$90+收益率上行=对久期敏感的科技股估值压缩；若持续将引发滞胀叙事风险

title.en: Nasdaq-100 Futures Down 0.9%; S&P 500 & Dow Also Off
title.zh: 纳指-100期货跌0.9%；标普500与道指亦弱

topNews.impact: Rate-sensitive mega-caps under pressure; September starts on a cautious tone as investors reprice risk.

macroRisk.en: Yield-driven repricing of growth valuations could persist if oil remains elevated above $85-90.
macroRisk.zh: 若油价持续高于$85-90，收益率驱动的估值再定价可能延续

title.en: Earnings Focus: MDT, DELL, PANW Heading Into Open
title.zh: 财报前瞻：MDT、DELL、PANW今日开盘前关注

topNews.impact: Medtronic and enterprise IT/AI infra names set to report; outcomes could offset geopolitical noise.

macroRisk.en: Earnings can anchor markets if AI/healthtech beat estimates despite broader weakness.
macroRisk.zh: 若AI/医疗科技超预期，财报可能锚定市场

ai.en: AI hardware demand remains structural, but short-term pain from elevated rates. Cloud hyperscalers and GPU makers face margin pressure on long-duration models.
ai.zh: AI硬件需求仍具结构性，但高利率环境下短期承压。云超大规模数据中心和GPU制造商面临长期模型定价压力

semiconductor.en: Chip stocks weak on rate fears; cyclical demand improving but valuations stretched. Watch for guidance from memory leaders.
semiconductor.zh: 芯片股受利率担忧拖累；周期性需求改善但估值偏高。关注内存龙头指引

bigTech.en: FAANG under pressure from yield repricing; cash-rich mega-caps defend but growth multiples compressed below 30x.
bigTech.zh: FAANG受利率再定价承压；现金充裕的巨头防御但成长倍数压缩至30倍以下

energy.en: Bullish on geopolitical premium; WTI above $90 with supply concerns from Middle East tensions. Watch for sustained >$85 support.
energy.zh: 地缘溢价驱动多头；WTI突破$90且中东紧张局势担忧供给。关注>85的支撑

ev.en: Mixed; high oil prices help ICE transition but auto stocks lag on rate-driven growth multiple compression.
ev.zh: 分化；高油价利好ICE转型但汽车股受利率驱动的成长倍数压缩拖累表现

market.en: Risk-off tone as broad-based weakness starts September; defensive tilt likely if oil/yields sustain pressure.
market.zh: 风险偏好降低，市场整体走弱展开9月；若油/收益率持续施压，防御性板块更受青睐

preciousMetals.en: Gold steady as safe-haven demand from tensions balances out rate hike fears; USD strength caps upside near $2,600.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金在紧张局势避险需求与加息担忧间平衡；美元走强限制$2,600上方上行空间

oil.en: WTI surges 2.7% above $90 on Iran escalation; sustained above $85-90 supports energy producers but risks inflation spiral.
oil.zh: WTI受伊朗升级催化上涨2.7%突破$90；持续高于85-90支持能源生产商但引发通胀螺旋风险

futures.en: Nasdaq futures -0.9%, S&P 500 -0.5%, Dow -0.45% to open on weak European session amid oil/yield pressure.
futures.zh: 纳指期货-0.9%，标普500-0.5%，道指-0.45%在油/收益率压力下于欧洲时段走弱开局

treasury10Y.en: Yields climb with oil spike; 10Y near 4.15-4.20% as inflation expectations embedded in energy reset.
treasury10Y.zh: 油价攀升带动收益率上行；10年期近4.15%-4.20%，通胀预期在能源重置中嵌入

dxy.en: Dollar strengthens marginally on safe-haven flows; DXY holds 97-97.5 range despite mixed economic prints.
dxy.zh: 避险资金推动美元边际走强；DXY持稳97-97.5区间

oil.en: WTI at $90+, Brent above $92 on Middle East risks; geopolitical premium dominates near-term oil outlook.
oil.zh: WTI在$90+，布油高于$92受中东风险催化；地缘溢价主导近期油价展望

keyRisk.en: Oil/yields combination could trap markets if sustained; watch for escalation in Middle East or Fed commentary on inflation.
keyRisk.zh: 若油/收益率组合持续，可能困住市场；警惕中东升级或美联储通胀评论

note.en: Geopolitical risk dominates but earnings season provides pockets of alpha; defensive tilt likely until inflation fears ease.
note.zh: 地缘政治风险主导但财报季提供局部alpha；通胀担忧缓解前防御性板块更受青睐
